summary.intent: Run the live phase-70 rotation-crash-safety e2e gate against real infra (docker stack + API) to validate 8 implemented plans, including a consequential assumption the executor flagged about Test 4's childless rotation root.
summary.outcome: 3 of 4 live gate tests passed (including the new Test 4, which did not hit the feared uncaught-AEAD-fail edge); Test 3 (concurrent-add strengthened) failed, and investigation confirmed a real production gap in Plan 70-04's enqueueConcurrentlyAddedChildren rather than a test-fixture issue — a fixer agent was dispatched to correct it and iterate against the live gate.

repo: docker/docker-compose.yml already provisions cipherbox-postgres, tee-worker, and mock-ipns-routing alongside ipfs:5001/redis:6380/someguy:8190 — no separate local postgres setup needed for live e2e
Live stack recipe: bring up docker compose, then `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api dev` on :3000, run sdk-e2e against localhost:3000
API's TEST_LOGIN_SECRET can differ from the e2e default; must pass SDK_E2E_SECRET explicitly aligned to it
Must rebuild core/sdk-core/sdk dists before running e2e so it exercises new (uncompiled-yet) code changes
TEE 404 warning on API boot in dev is expected noise (no TEE simulator running) and unrelated to rotation work

code.finding: Pushes a concurrently-added child onto the rotation BFS queue for its own rotateOne, which needs that child's IPNS write key — a key the rotating party may not structurally hold since a concurrent add implies a possibly different writer.

Orphaned-parent-pointer bug: the enqueue happens immediately before parentTracking.delete, so the parent's SealedChildRef.readKeySealed is never repointed, causing navigation to AEAD-fail even if the write key were available.
No try/catch around these, raising a theoretical uncaught-AEAD-fail concern for mid-walk crashes on multi-level trees — did not materialize as a blocker in Test 4's live run.

workflow: When a live gate test fails ambiguously, dispatch a classification agent first to distinguish 'test-fixture omission' from 'real engine gap' before attempting a fix — grounded the diagnosis in spec text (REQUIREMENT ROT-05, design §4.5) rather than guesswork
Author-only test writing (tsc-clean but unexecuted) plus GREEN-only implementation both hid this bug; only running the actual live gate against real infra surfaced it

friction: Test 3 (concurrent-add) failed with an opaque 'no valid IPNS private key' error that required a dedicated investigation to root-cause
e2e default secret didn't match the API's configured TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, requiring manual alignment before the gate could run
open_items: Fix enqueueConcurrentlyAddedChildren to merge + re-seal the child's SealedChildRef under the parent's new readKey (per ROT-05/design §4.5) instead of rotating the child in-walk
Fix the orphaned-parent-pointer ordering bug (enqueue vs parentTracking.delete)
Re-run the rotation-crash-safety live gate until all 4 tests pass before phase 70 can ship
Consider whether full re-key of concurrently-added children (deferred per design §4.5 as a 'follow-on') needs its own tracked follow-up phase
